narr: Deep monsoon moisture across northern provided the fuel for strong thunderstorms with heavy rain that caused flash flooding.
ev: Heavy rain over the Museum Fire scar caused flash flooding down Spruce Avenue Wash into north central Flagstaff. Debris flows, ash, logs, and flood waters up to three feet deep moved down the wash, over bridges, through streets, and the neighborhoods.
A flash flood down Dry Beaver Creek crossed Kimberlys Way making the road impassable.
A flash flood was reported over Highway 87 between Pine and Payson. Water was over the road with almost one lane covered. A road in East Verde Estates neighborhood flooded.
lsr: 3 FT. FLOWS THROUGH MOUNT ELDEN ESTATES, WITH LOGS AND DEBRIS IN THE FLOW.
